verdict.rationale: Operating a file-storage product through natural-language commands is a fair axis for OneDrive, so the story applies. The evidence pack only documents conventional UI actions and Microsoft Graph REST endpoints, such as search, createLink and upload sessions. Nothing shows a natural-language or conversational interface, and keyword search over items is an adjacent feature, not natural-language command operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
